changes: Add GET /vacancies/:vacancyId/shortlist: ApplicationService.shortlistForVacancy ranks received submissions for an employer-owned vacancy by the deterministic score (desc, then candidate id, then submission id) and returns rank, submissionId, score, aptitude, gapSummary and biasAlerts.
Authorize server-side: employer role, vacancy organization equals actor organization (403 otherwise), 401 unauthenticated, 404 unknown vacancy; candidate identifiers are not exposed.
Score via a trusted ShortlistSource (seed catalog ownership, persisted profile/preferences, existing matcher and counterfactual bias auditor); a bias-blocked vacancy yields an empty shortlist.
BFF route authenticates shortlist calls with the real cookie session and rejects dot-segment path aliases; shared catalog-input moved into agent-runtime.

commands: NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage npx vitest run apps/agent-runtime apps/web/tests --maxWorkers=1
skipped: No employer UI: the existing /empresa queue has no per-vacancy view to host the ranking cheaply.
validation.notes: Focused shortlist tests, service tests and BFF tests pass. Remaining failures are outside #100: apps/web/tests/chat-worker.test.ts (chat turns, PR #115 area) and the known pre-existing tsc errors.

riskRemaining: Ranking covers the seeded demo catalog only; ownership maps to the seeded employer organization.
